_comment: GitHub sends OIDC subjects with immutable numeric IDs appended to the owner and repo (repo:owner@OWNERID/repo@REPOID:ref:...), NOT the plain name form. A trust policy written against names is silently denied with 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'. Get the real subject before creating the role: trigger the workflow once, then read CloudTrail > Event history > AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity > userIdentity.userName, and paste that value below with the ref wildcarded. The IDs never change, so pinning them is both correct and rename-proof.
